Definition: Beeroth-Bene-Jaakan, a place in the Desert
BiblicalUsage: Beeroth-Bene-Jaakan means "wells." It was an encampment for Israel in the wilderness probably in the country of the Horites. You will find it in Deuteronomy 10:6.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Beeroth-Bene-Jaakan is worth knowing, because God's people actually walked there.
